title: A Delaware jury awards Qualcomm $2 in nominal damages after finding Arm breached its architectural license agreement and sought to disrupt Qualcomm's business (Tom Hals/Reuters)
summary: Tom Hals / Reuters: A Delaware jury awards Qualcomm $2 in nominal damages after finding Arm breached its architectural license agreement and sought to disrupt Qualcomm's business — Chip technology supplier Arm Holdings (O9Ty.F) breached a licensing agreement with Qualcomm (QCOM.O) and intentionally interfered …
